description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Tactical Awoken Mode], [Tactical Awoken Mode: Bartz (Earth)], [ATK +500 (25s) (Tactical)] to user.

description.name: Weapon Skill
description.text: One single piercing attack (11.00) capped at 199,999. Grants [Earth Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)], [Earth Ability DEF and RES 30% Piercing (Tactical)], [Instant ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1] to user, grants [Earth Ally 200% ATB 1 Follow-Up (Tactical)] to user/[Earth Ability FFV Boost (Tactical)] to user if there are 0-2/3+ FFV allies in the party.

description.name: Earth Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap for Earth attacks by 20000, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Earth Ability DEF and RES 30% Piercing (Tactical)
Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Earth Ally 200% ATB 1 Follow-Up (Tactical)
description.text: Grants [200% ATB 1] to the user after an ally uses an Earth ability, removed after triggering 4 times, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: 200% ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x2.00

description.name: Earth Ability FFV Boost (Tactical)
description.text: Earth abilities deal 30/40/50/60/70/30% more damage if there are 1/2/3/4/5 alive FFV allies, removed if the character hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Tactical Awoken Mode
description.text: Keeps track of TP level (0~6), increases TP level by 1 when the character is hit by a damaging attack or an ally uses a damaging action, casts a certain ability when TP level reaches 6. Removed after 8 abilities.

description.name: Tactical Awoken Mode: Bartz (Earth)
description.text: Earth abilities deal 30% more damage, have +10,000 damage cap, deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, trigger 2 additional times, have zero hone cost, penetrate 20% DEF and RES; removed if the character hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]
